sources.entry: Rygel - UPnP AV MediaServer that allows you to easily share audio, video, and pictures. Media player software may use Rygel to become a MediaRenderer that may be controlled remotely by a UPnP or DLNA Controller. (Source Code) LGPL-2.1 C

summary.name: Rygel
summary.one_liner: Rygel is a home media solution, a UPnP AV MediaServer that shares audio, video and pictures with DLNA/UPnP devices on the local network.
use_cases: Share local audio, video and pictures to a smart TV
Play PC media on a PlayStation 3 or other game console
Redirect sound output to DLNA speakers
Turn a media player into a remotely controlled DLNA renderer
Build a custom UPnP/DLNA server or renderer using Rygel libraries
summary.what_it_does: Rygel runs as a UPnP AV MediaServer that makes media stored on a PC visible to DLNA/UPnP devices such as TVs, game consoles and speakers. It converts media on the fly to formats the client device can handle, so content the TV or PS3 cannot natively play can still be streamed. Media player software can use Rygel as a MediaRenderer that a UPnP or DLNA controller can control remotely. Most functionality is provided through plug-ins. The project also ships shared libraries (librygel-core, -db, -server, -renderer, -renderer-gst, -ruih) for building plug-ins, renderers or replacement UPnP/DLNA servers.
notable: Converts media on the fly to formats client devices can play
Shared libraries for building custom UPnP-AV servers and renderers
caveats: Page does not specify Windows or macOS support; available for major Linux distributions per the page
Only LICENSE-level detail from listing: LGPL-2.1
